im_feedback_unavailable: This task recovery is unavailable or belongs to another Account.
im_feedback_not_started: The task did not start. No task operations were executed.
im_feedback_effects_unknown: External operations may already have occurred. Check the existing results before repeating this task.
im_feedback_workspace_paused: Work in this Session is paused. New input for this Session remains queued.
im_feedback_save_warning: Save and release this environment. The next allocation will restore the saved workspace; this does not repeat the original task.
im_feedback_discard_warning: Changes since the last successful save will be permanently lost. The previous complete archive will be retained. External operations, including messages and pull requests, will not be undone.
im_feedback_discard_ack: I understand that unsaved changes will be permanently lost and external operations will not be undone.
im_feedback_retry_warning: Queue one new attempt using the same input. The server will verify again that the previous attempt did not start and that no other attempt is active.
im_feedback_stale: The task or workspace changed. Refresh its result and review the operation again.
im_feedback_checking: Checking the operation result. Refresh the current result before deciding again; the operation will not be submitted automatically.
im_feedback_saved: Saved and environment released. The next allocation restores the workspace.
im_feedback_discarded: Unsaved changes discarded; the previous complete archive was retained.
im_feedback_queued: Retry queued. This does not mean the task has completed.
im_feedback_released_unverified: The environment was released, but the save/discard result could not be verified. Check the saved workspace before continuing.
im_feedback_failed: The operation could not complete. Check the current result before trying again.
im_feedback_no_actions: No recovery operation is currently available. Potentially completed or unknown task operations cannot be replayed here.
im_feedback_card_unknown: The error-card delivery result is unknown. Its original conversation must be checked before sending another card.
im_feedback_save_boundary: Changes since the last successful save may be lost. The last successful save time is unavailable here.
im_feedback_card_blocked: The error card could not be delivered. Check the Agent connection and its messaging permissions.
im_feedback_batch_retry_blocked: This frozen batch cannot be retried here. Open the original Task and review every input before starting new work.
im_feedback_owner_only_settings: Only the Agent owner can change its settings
im_feedback_owner_only_restore: Only the Agent owner can restore its connection
im_feedback_owner_only_task: Only the Agent owner can view this task
im_feedback_owner_only_agent: Only the Agent owner can view this Agent
